## Procedure and coverage

Flashed the logged build; loaded the default film file with Load Looks; took a photo in ART 1 and read its ImageDescription and ColorMatrix. Emulator free-space, op-check, boot, update-path, S6 and save-guard checks passed before the flash.

- The camera boots; Load Looks loads the default film file and ART 1 reads Portra 400.
- A photo in ART 1 records ImageDescription "Portra 400" and the ColorMatrix of the new Portra 400 fit.
- In this build film simulations get a 12-region table with every record off; Olympus's art filters keep theirs.
- Before the flash, a build with the same film specs plus an art-bracketing row (films-twelve-off-artbkt) ran two rounds, 78 JPEGs, with no fault.

## Limits and assumptions

- The RAW Data Edit colour check was not done on this build; the colour results (all 31 colour films closer to target, median natural-colour error 1.19 to 1.04) were measured on films-twelve-off-artbkt, not on this build.
- One owner and one camera; not reproduced by the Atlas.
- Not in a release when read; the newest release, v2026.11.20-rc.1, carries films-look-exif.
